selection_rationale: The page scored 67/100, lacked visible dates, dateModified, sources and the 700-word depth gate, and contained unqualified clinical claims about memory access, treatment superiority and a fixed breathing procedure. It was not covered by an active B013-B021 experiment and forms one cluster with performance anxiety.

baseline.unknown_policy: Missing exact-query GSC data is not treated as zero or failure.

acceptance_contract: Keep the existing URL and exact canonical
Remove unqualified causal and treatment-superiority claims
Lead with a cautious answer-first definition and explicit non-diagnostic boundary
Explain trigger, private experience, behavior and short-term/long-term consequences
Distinguish test anxiety from laziness, broader performance anxiety and general anxiety
Provide a bounded four-step observation procedure without prescribing risky self-exposure
Show verified systematic reviews and meta-analyses
Align visible publication/update dates with Article datePublished/dateModified
Align visible sources with Article citation and answer blocks with FAQPage
Add speakable selectors and consent-gated generic CTA markers
Connect the general anxiety guide, performance anxiety, procrastination and avoidance map
